# Work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Work>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A distinct abstract intellectual or artistic creation, independent of any language, notation, edition, or copy — the story, the composition, the visual conception. The most abstract tier of the WEMI spine; realized through one or more [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md). Identity changes when the creative content itself differs.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the abstract creation itself — the thing that survives translation, re-edition, and re-performance unchanged; the level a subject ([`gmeow:temporalCoverage`](../properties/gmeow-temporalCoverage.md)) and a creative-work type attach to.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the language, notation, or arrangement matters (that is [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md)), when an edition or format is meant ([`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)), or for a single copy ([`gmeow:Item`](gmeow-Item.md)); never attach a publisher, ISBN, or page count to a [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

### How to use

- Mint the [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md), link its realizations with [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](../properties/gmeow-realizedThrough.md), and record what it is ABOUT with gmeow:temporalCoverage/aboutness — kept distinct from when it was made; promote authorship to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](gmeow-Contribution.md) when role or period must be first-class.

### Examples

- ex:hamlet a [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md); [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](../properties/gmeow-realizedThrough.md) ex:hamletGermanTranslation; [`gmeow:temporalCoverage`](../properties/gmeow-temporalCoverage.md) ex:medievalDenmark.
